newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tractebel, Suez/Lyonnaise to remain separate - head.
newsitem.headline: Tractebel, Suez/Lyonnaise to remain separate - head.

text.p: Gerard Mestrallet, chief executive officer of new French utilities group Suez/Lyonnaise and chairman of utility holding company Tractebel SA said on Wednesday the two groups would continue as separate units.
"The new Suez/Lyonnaise group will ensure its international development from two platforms -- one in France, the other in Belgium," he told the annual meeting of Tractebel shareholders.
"Suez/Lyonnaise does not envision closer links between these two because it is not desirable...each has its reasons for existing and is successful," he said.
Tractebel is a unit of Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique SA (SGB), itself part of French Cie de Suez.
Both Tractebel and French group Lyonnaise des Eaux, which is to be merged with Suez later this year, are utilities and there have been concerns that overlaps between the two could result in a merger.
